verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic speaks named commerce protocols, ACP and UCP (adyen-agentic-docs-4, -5, -6, -7). Adyen also publishes OpenAPI definitions publicly on GitHub (adyen-agentic-gh-1), which suggests some open, readable API specs. However, nothing in the pack shows that ACP or UCP themselves are openly published, versioned, or usable without an agreement, and the docs-site OpenAPI probe returned 404s (adyen-agentic-probe-3). Missing for 10: evidence that the ACP/UCP specifications are openly published, an explicit versioning scheme for the protocol spec, confirmation that no license or contract is needed to read or implement it, and confirmation that the GitHub OpenAPI definitions cover the agentic commerce endpoints.
